resources.string: This APK keeps the legacy package name. Updating an existing installation requires the same signing certificate and a higher version code. An in-place update retains private settings and persistent VoLTE recovery backups; do not uninstall or clear app data first. The new-package version has separate data but changes the same device and SIM settings. Never enable auto-restore in both apps or run their writes concurrently.
Legacy package: a compatible in-place update retains private data and recovery backups. Do not clear data or enable auto-restore in both package versions.
